newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower in all months on Wednesday, as local investors continued to sell following Tuesday's price plunges, traders said.
Prices were 210 to 400 yen lower, and benchmark September was down 210 yen at 16,190 yen per tonne. "Investors expected further price falls by the end of this week," a trader said.
Price falls of CBOT overnight corn trading stepped up the selling, traders said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.50 per bushel at 0710 GMT, against $3.51-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
November CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system were at $8.10 at 0710 GMT, against $8.15 at Tuesday's close.
